name: Kissomlyó (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of white over green, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Kissomlyó: a crowned green shield with a yellow lion holding a sabre, with a helm and red mantling.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Kissomlyó arms with crown, helm and mantling
